[![Review Change Stack](https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/review-stack-in-coderabbit-ui.svg)](https://app.coderabbit.ai/change-stack/NVIDIA/NeMo-Agent-Toolkit/pull/2105?utm_source=github_walkthrough&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=change_stack) ## Walkthrough FunctionBase, DecomposedType, and TypeIntrospectionMixin replace `functools.lru_cache`-based memoization on instance methods with `functools.cached_property` or lazily initialized per-instance dictionary caches. A related test no longer clears a now-removed cache attribute. ### Changes **Instance-scoped caching refactor** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**FunctionBase properties moved to cached_property**
`packages/nvidia_nat_core/src/nat/builder/function_base.py`|Nine computed properties (`input_type`, `input_class`, `input_schema`, `streaming_output_type/class/schema`, `single_output_type/class/schema`) switch from `@property` + `@lru_cache` to `@cached_property`, with the `cached_property` import added.| |**DecomposedType properties moved to cached_property**
`packages/nvidia_nat_core/src/nat/utils/type_utils.py`|`origin`, `args`, `root`, `is_empty`, `is_class`, `is_generic`, `is_annotated`, `is_union`, `is_async_generator`, and `is_optional` switch from `@property` + `@lru_cache` to `@cached_property`.| |**TypeIntrospectionMixin methods switched to per-instance dictionary caches**
`packages/nvidia_nat_core/src/nat/observability/mixin/type_introspection_mixin.py`, `packages/nvidia_nat_core/tests/nat/observability/mixin/test_type_introspection_mixin.py`|`_extract_input_output_types`, `_get_union_info`, `_get_input_validator`/`_get_output_validator`, and `extract_non_optional_type` drop `@lru_cache` in favor of lazily initialized instance attribute caches; the test no longer calls `cache_clear()` on the removed cache.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~12 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Caller participant Instance as FunctionBase/DecomposedType instance participant Cache as Instance-level cache Caller->>Instance: Access cached property (e.g. input_type) Instance->>Cache: Check instance __dict__/cache attribute Cache-->>Instance: Return cached value if present Instance->>Instance: Compute value if not cached Instance->>Cache: Store result on instance Instance-->>Caller: Return value Note over Instance,Cache: Cache is freed when instance is garbage collected ```
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 5
✅ Passed checks (5 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :------------------------: | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | The PR replaces the leaked instance-method caches in FunctionBase, DecomposedType, and TypeIntrospectionMixin as requested by `#2104`. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | The changes stay within the cache-leak remediation scope, with only a small test adjustment to match the new caching behavior. | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title is concise, imperative, and accurately reflects the lru_cache memory leak fix in this change set. |

performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
